content: Extism 1.30.0 (2026-06-04) is a high-level plugin framework built ON TOP of wasmtime (its default runtime), adding bytes-in/bytes-out linking, PDKs for Go/Rust/Python/JS-TS/C/Zig/AssemblyScript/Haskell, persistent plugin-scoped vars, HTTP allowlisting without full WASI, and built-in operation/memory limiters. Wasmer is a lower-level 'universal runtime' competitor (WASIX, native-code AOT) not itself a plugin framework. wasmtime is the standards-first low-level runtime (Bytecode Alliance, Component Model) most others build on.
